title: What happens to the one-off and broken signing scripts (addLiquidity, deploySepoliaTest, recover-sell-ladys)?

options.name: Keep current behaviour: leave all three files as they are
options.risk: Two files that cannot load but would sign with the trading wallet on mainnet if their imports were "fixed" (AUD-SCRIPTS-001), and a one-off public sell with a 10% band and no fee cap (AUD-SCRIPTS-003); README.md keeps describing the first two as Sepolia helpers.

options.name: Delete all three
options.behavior_impact: no Sepolia bootstrap helper and no ready-made recovery sell; a stuck position is recovered with the bot exit engine or a new script written for that case
options.risk: If LADYS (or another lost position) is still held, the operator loses a ready tool and must use the dashboard force-sell or a new script.

options.name: Delete the two broken scripts; turn recover-sell-ladys into a general, hardened recovery sell
options.behavior_impact: one recovery script that takes token and router as arguments, holds the process lock (OD-68), sells privately with a tax-aware minimum, a short deadline and the bot fee caps
options.risk: A new money-path tool that needs its own tests; until it exists the old one stays as is.

options.name: Delete addLiquidity; rebuild deploySepoliaTest as a real Sepolia rehearsal tool
options.behavior_impact: a Sepolia-only deploy tool (SEPOLIA_RPC_URL, refuses unless chainId 11155111, testnet key only, constructor-correct FakeToken)
options.risk: Work for a tool nothing in the milestone needs; the contracts it deploys (Uniswap V2 router/factory, WETH) are not in the repo and would have to be added.

recommendation: delete-broken-keep-recovery if the operator wants a recovery tool, otherwise delete-all. The two broken scripts have no user (nothing reads src/addresses.json) and are a hazard if repaired.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase rules (milestone contract); nothing changes in Phase 22. None of these scripts runs unless the operator starts it, and two cannot load.
behavior_impact: Decides which manual signing tools exist after Phase 29.
needed_by: Phase 29 HYG-03 discussion (broken scripts removed or fixed)
